instructions: The move is happening now. Use the latest quote; if the session has closed by the time you write, use the close and say so. The company reported results today or last night: make the results the cause, and link the recap if one exists.

facts.name: On Holding
sentences: On Holding's shares moved 5% or more on 13 of the last 252 sessions.
The last move at least this big in the same direction was on 4 November 2026, when the stock rose 5.8%.
The stock is down 19.3% this year, and at $37.53 it sits 25.9% below its 52-week closing high of $50.63 from 8 January 2026.
$1,000 invested in On Holding five years ago would be worth $992 today.
